name: 06-resolution-email-person
description: Turn a company domain (plus an optional person name or job title) into a verified, send-safe email address - the deliverability-first "resolution" layer of a cold-email pipeline. Use when the user wants to find or verify a work email, enrich a list or file of domains into decision-maker contacts, or resolve "who is the [title] at [company] and what's their email." Works standalone or as Layer 06 in the API-First GTM stack. Cost-ordered waterfall: AI Ark → Prospeo → Blitz → Findymail with ZeroBounce validation; a rung is skipped when its API key is absent, and it never spends enrichment credit without an explicit go-ahead.
